candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with a no-op assignment that sets it to zero, causing AdjustBetAmounts to set betLimit = 0 regardless of input.
Replace assignment to set betLimit to the provided amount with assignment that doubles the provided amount before storing, causing a different stored value after call.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender equals whale instead of owner, allowing only the whale to call AdjustBetAmounts which can change betLimit observable behavior depending on caller.
Modify AdjustDifficulty to set difficulty to amount + 1 instead of amount, so public difficulty differs after call.
Modify AdjustDifficulty to set difficulty to amount - 1 instead of amount (allowing underflow is prevented by solidity >=0.8 so this will revert for amount == 0, changing observable behavior).
Modify AdjustDifficulty to invert stored value by setting difficulty = ~amount, changing the observable difficulty after the call.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require a different sender (owner must NOT be msg.sender), altering which caller can successfully invoke AdjustDifficulty and thus observable difficulty changes.
Change OpenToThePublic to set openToPublic = false instead of true, flipping the state after the call.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to invert the owner check, requiring msg.sender != owner so owner cannot call OpenToThePublic but others can.
Remove the state change so OpenToThePublic no longer alters openToPublic (no-op), leaving it unchanged after call.
Set openToPublic to the logical negation of its current value, toggling rather than always enabling public access.
